sections.name: My notes
sections.asr_prompt: The note-taker's own lines, typed during the meeting.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Never rewrite, reorder, summarise or correct this section. Reproduce it exactly as the author typed it.

sections.name: Attendees
sections.asr_prompt: Who was on the call, on both sides. Names, roles, company, who joined late.
sections.synthesis_prompt: List each attendee on its own line as 'Name — role, company'. Put the client's people first.

sections.name: Summary
sections.asr_prompt: What this call was about and where it ended up. Purpose, outcome, mood, agreement.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Three to five sentences a client could read without context. No internal commentary.

sections.name: What the client asked for
sections.asr_prompt: What the client asked for. Requests, wishes, complaints, changes, deadlines they need.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One bullet per request, in the client's own framing. Mark anything we have not agreed to yet.

sections.name: Decisions
sections.asr_prompt: Decisions made on the call. Agreed, approved, rejected, postponed, scope, price, dates.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One bullet per decision: what was decided and by whom.

sections.name: Action items
sections.asr_prompt: Who does what by when, on both sides. Assignee, task, due date, dependency.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One bullet per action in the form 'Owner: task — due date'. Keep our commitments and the client's clearly attributable to the right side.

sections.name: Open questions
sections.asr_prompt: Questions nobody answered on the call. Unknowns, blockers, things to find out.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One bullet per open question. Say who is expected to answer it, when that was said.

sections.name: Risks
sections.asr_prompt: Risks to the work. Timeline risk, budget risk, dependency, resourcing, misalignment.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One bullet per risk, with its impact in a few words.

sections.name: Next meeting
sections.asr_prompt: When the next conversation is. Date, time, who, agenda for it.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One line: when, with whom, and what it is for. Empty if nothing was agreed.
